items.required: Adopt an actual reviewed target-free exporter/verifier from the native complete calibration record and registry. Its exact source, distinct semantic review, schema, evidence and externally published release authority digest must be pinned. PRELAUNCH permits, FINISHED monitors, self-hashes and certificate acceptance alone do not prove scientific point admission.

Resolve native fixed-distance headline u length 3 versus the selected consumer u length 4 with a reviewed compatible consumer/policy successor or explicit bridge. Preserve native coordinate identity and original u custody; this writer neither pads nor silently transforms it. The compatible four-u mock is not evidence of real native compatibility.

The native rectangle membership predicate is independent for fixed inputs, but the current workflow exports scientific points only after the complete decision and two deterministic cache replays. If overlap is wanted, adopt and review an incremental native admission producer with identical scientific/certificate checks and fixed source identities. Do not label partial selected members, region or freeze as final.

Preserve or explicitly rule Claude4 S4-POST-S1 before-prediction requirement, tied to campaign FINAL_SUMMARY. This build supplies neither the transfer-test cases/thresholds nor its scientific decision.

Bind actual sealed V007 ADOPT_TAIL, exact case block/preregistration/compare/addendum, native COMPLETE and engine_ok, registry verification and recomputed membership, double replay, and guarded plan/admission hashes. The proposed target-free views are not existing native records and require an authentic reviewed producer.

Supply actual point-bound NGC EPS/LO proofs and reviewed validity replay for NGC91_K32_MS96, plus all GQ/route preflight conditions belonging to the selected calls. DDO call certificates do not establish NGC readiness. Synthetic outputs deliberately retain pending sentinels; filler success is not scientific acceptance.

The selected policy permits only r006_fallback or r007. A later r008 selection needs a reviewed consumer/policy and corresponding writer-binding successor. r007 requires the root driver acceptance pin. Route A/B specs are alternative interfaces to the same integrated A-to-B calculation; this is not a separate B-only reuse contract.

Claude2 must publish the exact release-authority digest independently of arbitrary input. Codex3 and Codex2 own the dispatch-requested external review. Complete reviewed producer/source closure is required; the in-process verifier restrictions are not a hostile-code security sandbox. Every output remains launch_authorized false; only Claude2 can authorize scientific execution.
